Mentorship

University students in North America have expressed interest in mentoring.

Responsibilities

Help a team test an idea or work through a problem. Older students mentor younger teams with an adult coach.

Skills

Bring teaching, engineering, or a trade you can show a child.

Availability

Adults send this form. If you’re under 18, ask a parent or guardian. Please don’t include a child’s birth date, a school ID, financial documents, or account numbers.
